newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tsann Kuen Jan-April turnover up 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tsann Kuen Jan-April turnover up 23 pct.

text.p: Turnover of Chinese household appliance maker Tsann Kuen (China) Enterprise Co Ltd rose to $59.65 million in January-April 1997, an increase of 23 percent from the year-ago period, the company said on Wednesday.

The Shenzhen-listed firm's unaudited turnover in the first four months was 495.1 million yuan ($59.65 million), up from 401.64 million yuan in the same period last year, the company said in a statement.
The company attributed the increase to stronger demand for its products, it said, but did not give a profit figure for the period.
The firm said output of its most competitive product, clothing irons, would rise to 5.5 million units in 1997 from 4.02 million last year.

Tsann Kuen posted turnover of 896.67 million yuan for 1996 against 784.09 million yuan in 1995 under Chinese accounting standards, with net profits jumping to 46.46 million yuan from 35.88 million yuan.
Under international accounting standards, the company posted net profits of 55.53 million yuan for 1996 against 38.39 million yuan in 1995.
